name: What should I ask a contractor before starting renovation planning?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a contractor before I hire them for renovation planning?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a contractor before I hire them for renovation planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor for renovation planning, ask questions that reveal how they manage the full pre-construction process, not just the build. Key questions include whether they provide design support, who prepares permit drawings, how they handle engineering, what their typical approval timeline looks like, and how they manage corrections from the city. It is also important to ask about communication cadence, cost tracking, and change orders. For Los Angeles projects, local experience matters because permitting, inspections, and neighborhood constraints can affect the schedule. Ask whether they have completed similar remodels in your area and whether they understand city-specific review patterns. Also ask what happens if hidden issues are found after demolition. A strong contractor should explain how they document surprises, price revisions, and schedule impacts. The best planning conversations happen before a contract is signed, when scope and expectations are still flexible.
